description: Compare every Qwen3.5-4B next-token logit and output ranking between pinned Hugging Face Transformers/PyTorch ROCm and the production Kiln Vulkan resident/nonresident paths.

variables.name: trainer_python
variables.description: Python executable containing the exact requirements-sft.lock ROCm Torch, Transformers, and safetensors environment.

variants.description: Generate an independent full-vocabulary HF reference on pinned ROCm Torch, release it, then compare the source-pinned model through required RADV Vulkan execution.

cases.description: Run the pinned HF torch-fallback forward in a private-network process boundary, then compare all 248,320 logits, argmax, and top-10 ranking through Vulkan.
